text: A live turn is one LangGraph pass: update_time, route_turn, retrieve_memory, agent, tools, then reflect.
Memory lives in PostgreSQL with pgvector: 768-dimensional embeddings and an HNSW index over the memories table.
The phylactery is the database holding the agent's identity anchor and memory; a restored dump brings the agent back on any machine.
Retrieval ranks by cosine similarity, drops candidates below the similarity floor, then applies one distrust multiplier for unverified and old rows.
Write hygiene blocks junk at save time: the junk gate, the USER and AGENT label check, and the provenance filter that requires overlap with this turn's tool output.
The reverie loop runs background passes: Pulse intents first, then an optional solitary pass with rotating P1 discover, P2 hygiene, and P3 rhythm lanes.
The loop budget stops a turn on wall clock, on a repeated tool batch, or on a fruitless round; the round cap is only a runaway backstop.
The agent binds twenty-two tools: memory, diary, lessons, knowledge graph, time, web, intents, selftest, and outreach.
Proactive outreach is two stages: message_user enqueues a draft into the outbox, and the Heart process delivers it to Telegram.
Mind Hub records one timeline in mind_events: user input, agent output, solitary passes, and outreach queued or sent.
Causal lessons store a change and a because pair; the top hits are injected as LESSON lines during retrieval.
Web search runs through a local SearXNG on loopback, then ddgs, Playwright, and Wikipedia; fetch_url and browse_web block private addresses.
